effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until their turn ends. Then, by choosing 1 of your Digimon, delete the chosen Digimon, and 1 of their Digimon gets -6000 DP until their turn ends.
